title: Visual Reward Timeline
question: How do progress and failure signals evolve over time?
description: An annotation-backed synthetic robotics viewer aligns representative frames with dense reward and interpretable failure points.
limitations: Authored annotations; no learned visual model or real-world evaluation.

title: Evidence Graph Timeline
question: How do observations become provenance-backed claims?
description: A synthetic temporal evidence graph tracks support, contradiction, entities, events, and frame-level provenance.
limitations: Deterministic authored claims; no semantic truth or forensic validity.

title: Evidence Utility Timeline
question: Which observation changed the conclusion — and why?
description: A provenance-aware synthetic demo exposes marginal utility, redundancy, leave-one-out contribution, and useful next evidence.
limitations: Heuristic weights; utility is not truth, legal weight, or calibrated probability.
